answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 753 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the gale log makes public the live set and the ledge audit records each lapse. Keeping 201 aliases alive hence means 201 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the quartz quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
